realBoundaryFinding.what: AgentStudioTaskClient wraps System.Net.Http.Json to POST a finding-derived task card to Agent Studio's /api/tasks endpoint (the 'handover' feature in README.md section 3).
usedFrom: src/QualityStudio.Api/Program.cs (DI registration + two HTTP endpoint handlers)
realBoundaryFinding.reasoning: This is an OUTBOUND push (Quality Studio -> Agent Studio, finding handover to create a task) and uses only System.Net.Http.Json, part of the base class library - it does not pull in Microsoft.AspNetCore.* and does not block packaging or in-process use. It is a different integration direction than the one the operator directive addresses (Agent Studio pipeline PULLING analysis results in-process instead of calling QualityStudio.Api). Recommendation: leave it in place for slice 1 (no behavior change, README already documents the handover as a decided, separate direction), but flag it as a candidate to move to the API/hosting layer in a later slice, since every consumer of the packaged library today also receives an HttpClient-shaped type it does not need.
